2122027015037464806.en_summary: This is out of date because of the price-insensitive bid. "Back to normal" for U.S. stocks could mean a fall of anywhere from 11% to 41%, depending on the yardstick. But those averages assume the same market structure since 1979. Passive flows are inelastic: $1 in has been estimated to lift market value by about $5. That likely raised the fair multiple. It didn't raise earnings. (Quoting jasonfurman on AI bubble risks, baseline 25% fall.)
2122027015037464806.zh_summary: 這因價格不敏感的買盤而過時。「回到正常」對美國股票可能意味著11%到41%的下跌，取決於標準。但那些平均假設自1979年以來相同的市場結構。被動資金流是非彈性的：估計1美元流入可提升市場價值約5美元。這可能提高了公允倍數。它沒有提高收益。（引用jasonfurman關於AI泡沫風險，基線25%下跌。）
